selection_basis: Wave 7 selects the two largest remaining source-ready gaps with high marginal exam value: quantity/classification has 19 verified questions against a target of 60, and incident decision has 3 against 30. Calculation-boundary is also sparse, but the completed Wave 5 review rejected its broad curriculum-level variants; it is not reopened until a more specific authoritative source-defined proposition is found. No third range is permitted.

authoring_rule: Enumerate source-defined propositions before authoring, collision-check against all 286 canonical/source-verified questions and the full Wave 7 peer set, and stop without backfill when material distinctions are exhausted.
multi_source_rule: Each candidate binds to one registered source_id, source_version and reproducible pinpoint locator. Cross-source answer-defining comparisons are prohibited without an approved source-bundle contract.
